question: Why is Christian Watson scoring so many fantasy points this season?
answer:
Opportunity is the primary driver: an 80.3% average snap share and 22.2% target share over 6 games yield 19.8 PPR points per game (23.1 in weeks 1-3, 16.5 in weeks 4-6). A strong team pass rate of 67.5% average (76.2% in losses vs 63.2% in wins/ties) further inflates his target volume. Big-play ability cements the scoring, with 11.2 yards per target (10.6 early, 13.9 later), a 32.4% air yards share, and 10 plays of 20+ yards. Verdict: start Christian Watson.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.week, ps.opponent_team, sc.offense_snaps, ROUND(100 * sc.offense_pct, 1) AS snap_pct, ps.targets, ROUND(100 * ps.target_share, 1) AS target_share_pct, ps.receptions, ps.carries, ROUND(ps.fantasy_points_ppr, 1) AS ppr_points FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps LEFT JOIN NFLVERSE.snap_counts sc ON sc.game_id = ps.game_id AND sc.player = ps.player_display_name AND sc.team = ps.team WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id = '00-0038124' ORDER BY ps.week

factors.summary: Average pass rate 67.5%; 2 losses, 4 wins or ties. Pass rate 76.2% in losses vs 63.2% in wins or ties. Pass rate: 72.3% in weeks 1-3 vs 62.8% in weeks 4-6.
factors.rule: PPR per game in above-average pass-rate weeks minus the rest: 11.8 (strong >= 5, moderate >= 2, weak > 0)

evidence.sql: SELECT p.week, MAX(p.defteam) AS opponent, SUM(p.pass) AS pass_plays, SUM(p.rush) AS rush_plays, ROUND(100 * SUM(p.pass) / NULLIF(SUM(p.pass) + SUM(p.rush), 0), 1) AS pass_rate_pct, MAX(CASE WHEN s.home_team = 'GB' THEN s.home_score - s.away_score ELSE s.away_score - s.home_score END) AS final_margin FROM NFLVERSE.pbp p JOIN NFLVERSE.schedules s ON s.game_id = p.game_id WHERE p.season = 2026 AND p.posteam = 'GB' GROUP BY p.week ORDER BY p.week

factors.summary: 538 receiving yards on 48 targets (11.2 yards per target); 10 plays of 20+ yards; longest 81. Average air yards share 32.4%. Yards per target: 10.6 in weeks 1-3 vs 13.9 in weeks 4-6.
